turns.content: Hi! How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to cancel my flights under reservation ID SI5UKW and I’d like to get a refund, please.

To assist you with your cancellation and refund request, I need your user ID for verification. Could you please provide your user ID? Additionally, may I know the reason for your cancellation (change of plan, airline cancelled flight, or other reasons)? This will help determine your eligibility for a refund.
Sure, my user ID is amelia_rossi_1297. The reason is a change of plans—I won’t be able to travel anymore. But I really need to cancel and get my money back, so please help me with the refund process.

Thank you for providing your user ID and reason for cancellation.

Before proceeding, I need to inform you that for basic economy reservations, cancellations for a refund are only allowed if:
- The booking was made within the last 24 hours,
- The flight is cancelled by the airline,
- The user has travel insurance and the reason is covered.

Your reservation was made on 2024-05-11, which is more than 24 hours ago, and you do not have travel insurance. Unless the airline has cancelled your flight, I am unable to process a refund for this basic economy reservation.

Would you like me to check if your flight has been cancelled by the airline, or do you have any other questions?

I understand your policy, but I really can’t use these tickets and it’s a lot of money to just lose. Isn’t there anything you can do? Even if it’s just a travel voucher or a gift card for future use, I’d really appreciate some flexibility here. I’m a loyal customer and I’d hate to feel like I’m being penalized for something out of my control. Can you please escalate this or find a way to help me out?

Thank you for your understanding and for being a loyal customer. According to our policy, compensation such as travel vouchers or certificates can only be offered if you are a silver or gold member, have travel insurance, or are flying business class. As a regular member with a basic economy ticket and no insurance, I am unable to offer a voucher or certificate.

If you would like, I can escalate your request to a human agent for further review. Would you like me to transfer you to a human agent who may be able to assist further?

Honestly, I think this policy is really unfair. I’m not asking for a full refund, but at least give me something back—maybe a 50% refund or even just 10%. I can’t just throw away all that money. If you can’t do it, then please escalate this to someone who can actually help. I’m not going to accept losing the entire value of my ticket. There must be some way to work this out, even if it’s just a partial refund or a travel credit. Can you please make an exception or get a supervisor involved?
